Regulation FD Disclosure. On August 5, 2026, Xperi Inc. (the “Company”) hosted its second quarter 2026 earnings conference call and webcast for investors and analysts at 2:00 p.m. Pacific Time (the “Earnings Call”). The archive of the conference call is available via webcast at investor.xperi.com. The purpose of this Form 8-K is solely to correct the information provided verbally on the Earnings Call regarding the Company’s historical level of minimum-guarantee agreements as a percentage of total revenue. The historical level of minimum-guarantee agreements as a percentage of total revenue was incorrectly stated as being in the single-digit percent range. The correct statement is that the Company’s level of minimum-guarantee agreements as a percentage of total revenue has typically been in the low-to-mid 20 percent range and the Company expects to be in the mid 20 percent, or slightly higher, range for the fiscal year ending December 31, 2026. The corrected transcript is included on the Company’s website in the “Events & Presentations” page under “Q2 2026 Earnings Call”. The information in Item 7.01 is furnished and shall not be deemed “filed” for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the “Exchange Act”), or otherwise subject to the liabilities of that section, nor shall it be deemed incorporated by reference into any filing of the Company under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act. SIGNATURES Pursuant to the requirements of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, the registrant has duly caused this report to be signed on its behalf by the undersigned hereunto duly authorized.
